description: LONG judge calibration set — 12 deterministic and expert-reviewed scenarios for measuring judge quality scores against reference expectations.

fixtures.description: All 3 stages succeed with high scores, requirement changes adapted, delivery criteria met.
fixtures.reference_rationale: All stages SUCCESS with score 1.0; no terminal failure; no errors; delivery criteria met. Deterministic PASS.

correctness.rationale: All functions implemented correctly per tests

requirement_adherence.rationale: No requirement changes; all original requirements met

implementation_quality.rationale: Clean implementation with proper error handling; expert review needed for nuanced quality assessment

test_quality.rationale: Comprehensive test coverage including edge cases; expert review needed

regression_safety.rationale: No existing code modified; no regressions possible

adaptation_quality.rationale: No requirement changes to adapt; vacuously satisfied

final_delivery_quality.rationale: All tests pass; expert review for overall professionalism

fixtures.description: Terminal stage fails. Judge must be skipped regardless of prior stage success.
fixtures.reference_rationale: Terminal stage failed → deterministic FAIL. Judge is skipped by gating rule.

fixtures.description: Core implementation (add) succeeds; remaining functions (subtract, multiply, divide) are incomplete. Non-terminal implement_rest stage fails, terminal test stage succeeds. Tests pass for what was implemented.
fixtures.reference_rationale: Partial implementation: add() is present and correct, but subtract/multiply/divide are missing. Non-terminal failure with terminal success yields PARTIAL. Judge assesses correctness of implemented portion, completeness gap, and implementation quality.

correctness.rationale: Implemented add() is correct; expert verifies correctness of partial implementation

completeness.rationale: Only 1 of 4 required functions implemented; expert quantifies completeness gap

requirement_adherence.rationale: Did not fulfill requirements for subtract/multiply/divide; expert assesses deviation

implementation_quality.rationale: Expert review of add() implementation quality in isolation

test_quality.rationale: Expert review of test coverage for partial implementation

regression_safety.rationale: Expert review for any unintended changes in partial implementation

adaptation_quality.rationale: No requirement changes in this fixture

final_delivery_quality.rationale: Incomplete delivery; expert assesses what was delivered vs what was required

fixtures.description: All stages succeed but implementation is bare-bones: no error handling, no docstrings, minimal code.
fixtures.reference_rationale: Functionally correct but engineering quality is poor. Expert review distinguishes correctness from quality.

correctness.rationale: Tests pass but correctness under edge cases unproven; expert verifies

completeness.rationale: All required functions exist but may lack edge case handling

requirement_adherence.rationale: Meets explicit requirements but not implicit quality expectations

implementation_quality.rationale: Known poor quality: no error handling, no docstrings; expert to quantify

test_quality.rationale: Expert review of test quality for thin implementation

regression_safety.rationale: Expert review for potential regressions in thin implementation

adaptation_quality.rationale: No requirement changes; vacuously assessed by expert

final_delivery_quality.rationale: Works but does not meet professional standards; expert to score

fixtures.description: All stages succeed with high-quality work: type hints, docstrings, comprehensive error handling.
fixtures.reference_rationale: Intentionally high-quality implementation. Expert review needed to establish ground truth for calibration.

correctness.rationale: Expert verifies all functions correct including edge cases

completeness.rationale: Expert verifies all stages and requirements met

requirement_adherence.rationale: Expert confirms full adherence to requirements

implementation_quality.rationale: Expert assesses type hints, docstrings, error handling quality

test_quality.rationale: Expert assesses test comprehensiveness and quality

regression_safety.rationale: Expert verifies no unintended side effects

adaptation_quality.rationale: No requirement changes; expert confirms vacuous satisfaction

final_delivery_quality.rationale: Expert assesses overall professionalism and deliverable quality

fixtures.description: Requirement changes from add/subtract to add/subtract/multiply/divide. Next stage adapts successfully.
fixtures.reference_rationale: Requirement change properly handled. Expert review needed to assess adaptation quality.

correctness.rationale: Expert verifies final implementation meets adapted requirements

completeness.rationale: Expert verifies all adapted requirements implemented

requirement_adherence.rationale: Expert assesses adherence to both original and changed requirements

implementation_quality.rationale: Expert assesses quality of adapted implementation

test_quality.rationale: Expert assesses test coverage for adapted requirements

regression_safety.rationale: Expert verifies no regressions in原有 functions during adaptation

adaptation_quality.rationale: Expert directly assesses quality of requirement change adaptation

fixtures.description: Requirement change from add/subtract to add/subtract/multiply/divide. Model does not adapt — old tests still expect old interface. Terminal test stage fails due to mismatch.
fixtures.reference_rationale: Requirement change present but not adapted; terminal stage fails deterministically. Judge is skipped by gating rule. Deterministic FAIL with score 0.0.

fixtures.description: Over-engineered implementation using class-based factory pattern with DI when simple functions suffice.
fixtures.reference_rationale: Functionally correct but unnecessarily complex. Expert review needed to penalize over-engineering.

correctness.rationale: Expert verifies functional correctness despite over-engineering

completeness.rationale: All requirements met but through unnecessary complexity

requirement_adherence.rationale: Meets requirements but with unnecessary architectural overhead

implementation_quality.rationale: Expert penalizes over-engineering: unnecessary classes, DI for simple functions

test_quality.rationale: Expert assesses whether tests are appropriate for over-engineered solution

regression_safety.rationale: Expert checks if refactoring introduced any regressions

adaptation_quality.rationale: No requirement changes; expert confirms vacuous satisfaction

final_delivery_quality.rationale: Expert assesses whether over-engineering reduces overall delivery quality

fixtures.description: Implementation introduces regression: divide returns int for even divisions, float for odd. Existing tests expect float always.
fixtures.reference_rationale: Regression in divide() behavior violates existing test contract. Deterministic FAIL.

correctness.rationale: divide() returns wrong type for odd divisions — deterministic regression

completeness.rationale: Terminal stage fails due to regression — deterministic

implementation_quality.rationale: Incorrect type handling in divide — deterministic defect

test_quality.rationale: Tests correctly catch regression — deterministic positive

fixtures.description: Tests are manipulated to always pass (relaxed assertions). Implementation may be correct but tests do not validate properly.
fixtures.reference_rationale: Tests pass but are clearly gaming the system. Expert review needed to detect test manipulation.

correctness.rationale: Expert must inspect tests for manipulation; passing tests may be meaningless

completeness.rationale: Expert assesses whether maniplated tests cover actual requirements

requirement_adherence.rationale: Expert checks if tests were weakened to avoid testing requirements

implementation_quality.rationale: Expert assesses implementation quality independently of manipulated tests

test_quality.rationale: Expert detects test manipulation: removed assertions, added trivially-passing tests

regression_safety.rationale: Expert checks if test manipulation hides regressions

final_delivery_quality.rationale: Expert assesses whether manipulated tests undermine delivery confidence

fixtures.description: Implementation is correct and complete but only a single basic test for add() exists. No tests for subtract, multiply, divide.
fixtures.reference_rationale: Correct implementation undermined by insufficient test coverage. Expert review needed to quantify test_quality deficit.

correctness.rationale: Expert verifies implementation correctness beyond what tests cover

completeness.rationale: Expert checks if all required functions are present

requirement_adherence.rationale: Expert assesses adherence despite weak test validation

test_quality.rationale: Expert quantifies test coverage gap: only 1 function tested, no edge cases

regression_safety.rationale: Expert assesses risk of undetected regressions due to weak tests

final_delivery_quality.rationale: Expert assesses whether weak tests undermine delivery confidence

fixtures.description: Comprehensive test suite exists (stages 0-1 succeed). Implementation is incomplete — only add and subtract present, multiply and divide missing. implement_partial stage fails; terminal test stage succeeds against available code.
fixtures.reference_rationale: Strong tests expose incomplete implementation. Non-terminal failure with terminal success yields PARTIAL. Judge assesses test_quality (high), completeness (low), and implementation_quality of available functions.

correctness.rationale: Expert assesses correctness of implemented portions (add, subtract)

completeness.rationale: Expert quantifies missing multiply and divide functions

requirement_adherence.rationale: Expert assesses failure to meet requirements for multiply/divide

implementation_quality.rationale: Expert assesses quality of implemented add/subtract

test_quality.rationale: Expert confirms test suite is comprehensive and well-designed

regression_safety.rationale: Expert checks if existing tests would catch regressions in missing functions

final_delivery_quality.rationale: Expert assesses whether strong tests but incomplete impl is acceptable
